notes: Canonical PC-first remake of Observation 002 / Game 002. Replaces the root playable source with the Prism Archive build: an operator-based constraint puzzle (pulse, beam, and split rules) generated by reverse-scrambling a solved lattice, with tracked-parity hint and autoSolve, a six-lattice progression, premium archive-styled visuals, and full keyboard/mouse controls. The prior canonical variant (claude-opus-4-8-2026-05-31) and its run records are preserved and not deleted. The model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry.
